content: Captions (captions.ai; iOS app now branded Dubs): mobile-first AI video editor for talking videos - auto subtitles, teleprompter, AI dubbing/translation, AI script writing, AI edits; subscription monetization (weekly Pro plan typical). No ad/token economy observed: mobile AI video apps monetize via subscription, not rewarded ads. A separate Android app named Captions (Pixster) offers auto-captions and teleprompter.
